title: More Love, More Power
lyrics: Verse 1:
[Em]More love, [Cmaj7]more power, [Bm7]more of You in [Em]my life.[D/E]
[Em]More love, [Cmaj7]more power, [Bm7]more of You in [Em]my life.[D/E]
Chorus 1:
And I will worship [Am7]You with all of my [Em7]heart,
And I will worship [Am7]You with all of my [Em7]mind,
And I will worship [Am7]You with all of my [Em7]strength,
For You are my [Cmaj7]Lord. [Bm7]You are my Lord
Chorus 2:
And I will seek Your face with all of my heart,
And I will seek Your face with all of my mind,
And I will seek Your face with all of my strength,
For You are my God.
Chorus 3:
And I will praise your name with all of my heart,
And I will praise your name all of my mind,
And I will praise your name with all of my strength,
For You are my lord, You are my Lord
Bridge 1:
[Bm7]For You are my [Cmaj7]Lord.[Bm7Em2]
